Creating a group

A group collects users so you can grant them access to projects together. Only admins can create groups, and every group name must be unique within the organization.

Using the API¶

Send a POST request with the group name. The response contains the new group's identifier, which you need when adding members later on.

curl -X POST https://example.test/api/groups \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"name": "platform"}'

Limits

The following limits apply to groups in every plan, and requests over a limit are rejected with an error.

SettingLimit
Members per group500
Groups per organization100
